hooks.name: Scaffold a new decay policy

action.prompt:
Scaffold a new decay policy for the app named in the prompt (ask if none is given).
Create, under apps/<app-name>/src/:
1. policy.ts implementing the DecayPolicy contract exactly as defined in the "Type Contract" section of .kiro/specs/engine/requirements.md. Do not invent other signatures. Every function body is a TODO: decay rules are hand-written by the developer (see .kiro/steering/authorship.md). Do not write them.
2. skin.css with placeholder CSS variables (--bg, --panel, --line, --text, --dim, --acc, --good, --warn, --bad) and a comment naming the app's metaphor.
3. policy.test.ts with empty outcome-test and property-test stubs: health stays 0-100, same input gives same output, healthAt never increases between events, the policy passes checkPolicy, and one outcome test ("dies on day N if never tended").
Do not modify packages/engine. Log this in docs/KIRO_LOG.md.

hooks.description: Creates the starting files for a new app's decay policy, skin and tests.
